stories.title: Antonelli Can Make History Sunday — The Championship Clinch Scenario Explained

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli is 2 days from becoming the youngest F1 world champion in history.

He would be 20 years and 61 days old — shattering Vettel's record of 23 years, 134 days (2010).

The clinch conditions are narrow. But they're real. #F1 #USGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
For Antonelli to clinch Sunday at COTA:

✅ Win the race
✅ Russell finishes P9 or lower
✅ Hamilton finishes P5 or lower

102-point lead. 150 remaining. The end could be this weekend. #F1 #USGP

article.headline: Antonelli Can Make History at COTA: The Championship Clinch Scenario Explained

stories.title: Hamilton and Ferrari Arrive as COTA Favorites — Friday Practice Reveals the Race Pace

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton has won at COTA before.

Ferrari arrives in Austin with strong recent pace. FP1 starts at 12:30 PM CT.

If anyone can slow Antonelli's title party, it might be Hamilton and the red car. #F1 #USGP

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
FP1 and FP2 done at COTA.

Ferrari and Mercedes both have championship stakes in this race — one wants to win it, one wants to delay losing it.

The pecking order is starting to emerge. #F1 #USGP

article.headline: Hamilton and Ferrari Arrive as COTA Favorites: Friday Practice Will Reveal Everything

stories.title: Russell's Zero-Margin Weekend — How Practice Shapes His Survival

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
George Russell's weekend at COTA in one sentence:

Win the race, have Antonelli finish P9 or lower, and hope Hamilton doesn't show up.

One slip ends the title fight. No backup plan. #F1 #USGP

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
For Russell, Friday at COTA isn't just practice.

It's the foundation of a must-win weekend.

Front-row start essentially mandatory. Race win non-negotiable.

The most important qualifying session of his season starts Saturday. #F1 #USGP

article.headline: Russell's Zero-Margin Weekend: How COTA Practice Shapes His Title Survival

stories.title: Verstappen Eyes a Fourth Straight COTA Win — History, Bumps, and Spoiler Duty

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen has won the last three US Grands Prix at COTA (2021, 2022, 2023).

He can't win the championship this year.

But he can win the race — and stop Antonelli from clinching on Sunday.

History. Spoiler. COTA king. #F1 #USGP
